sources.notes: 9 Prisma models. User.role restricted to STUDENT|ADMIN. No BadgeAward, Cohort, Supervisor, or Notification models. SQLite datasource.
NextAuth v4 CredentialsProvider only. JWT 7-day maxAge. role copied into token. DUMMY_PASSWORD_HASH used for timing-attack mitigation. NEXTAUTH_SECRET has no fallback.
Firebase Admin SDK. Auto-enables when service-account env vars are present. Spark tier. Singleton Firestore instance.
Dual-write helpers for 5 collections: users, progress, examAttempts, exerciseAttempts, feedbackReports. Failures logged and never throw. No read path. passwordHash deliberately omitted from syncUser.
8 lines. Deny-all client access (`allow read, write: if false`).
31 badges: 5 progress_achievement, 16 applied_skill, 5 cross_section_capability, 5 capstone_credential. version 1.0.0, generated_by badge_architect node (Phase 6).
707 lines. EligibilityEngine class. evaluate() and awardIdempotent(). Awards mutate in-memory LearnerProgress.awarded_badges; no Prisma write.
LearnerProgress interface (in-memory). AwardedBadge, BadgeSpec, EligibilityReport types. 228 lines.
IS_STATIC_SITE = NEXT_PUBLIC_STATIC_SITE === '1'. SITE_BASE_PATH helper. Used by progress-store and API routes.
Dual path: localStorage for static, Prisma for dynamic. Server writes short-circuit when IS_STATIC_SITE.
481 lines. Computes 'cohorts' as activity-based analytics filters (active_7d, at_risk, phase1, etc.) — NOT user-assignable cohorts with managers.
output: 'export' (static) or 'standalone' (dynamic) based on NEXT_OUTPUT env. basePath/assetPrefix for /pyarcana GitHub Pages subpath.
~15,700 lines. Seeds QuestionBank + 3 SubscriptionPlan tiers (free/pro/team). Explicitly creates no users. Team plan featuresJSON includes 'Reportes de progreso para managers' marketing bullet.
DATABASE_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL, FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID/CLIENT_EMAIL/PRIVATE_KEY. No E2E_ADMIN_* here — those are only in scripts/e2e_max/helpers/auth.ts.
GitHub Pages deployment only. bun install + bun run build:static + upload-pages-artifact. No DB provisioning, no dynamic LMS deploy.
E2E_ADMIN = { email: process.env.E2E_ADMIN_EMAIL || '', password: process.env.E2E_ADMIN_PASSWORD || '' }. No fallback. Used by loginViaApi in E2E specs.
2,279 lines. 5 roles × 4 levels. 352 URLs harvested. HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW confidence ratings. Source for Phase 1 badge revalidation.
796 lines. 41 gaps (6 P0, 7 P1, 15 P2, 5 P3, 8 P4). 16 uncovered industry skills, 4 of which are critical. Source for Phase 1 badge gap report.
62 skill nodes, 5 roles (data_analyst, data_scientist, rpa_automation_developer, ai_ml_engineer, production_python_engineer) × 4 levels. 8 critical competencies. 59 skill dependencies.
